title: Dimension X
paragraphs: NBC science-fiction anthology adapting stories by leading genre writers alongside original radio scripts, with tales of space travel, alien contact, future societies, and dangerous technology.
Adult NBC science-fiction anthology adapting major published SF alongside original radio plays. The first 25 are retained as documented archive-scope absence, not fabricated episode rows.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Complete 50-program NBC run (April 8, 1950 to September 29, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], Frozen programs 26-34 (September 29, 1950 to January 14, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Frozen programs 35-50 (June 3, 1951 to September 29, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|norman-rose|Norman Rose]] (host), William Welch (producer), Albert Buhrman (music), Edward King (director), Ernest Kinoy (radio adaptor and writer), Fred Weihe (director and transcriber), and George Lefferts (radio adaptor and writer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and [[org|org.66865a83f6609315|KFI]].

The stories often return to adapted science-fiction literature, space exploration and interplanetary travel, technology, automation and scientific risk, alien contact and extraterrestrial life, human identity, androids and artificial persons, and nuclear war and post-apocalyptic society.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Adult science fiction becomes a sustained radio anthology, Published science-fiction adaptation pipeline, Five-month 1951 hiatus, and Dimension X scripts reused by X Minus One.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]], [[show|the-chase|The Chase]], [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], and [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]].
